system.description: With a foe Restrained by you and both of you next to a prop, you drive its head into the soot-black stone. Test Agility (DR16). On a success, it takes d12 damage and is Slowed until the end of its next turn, and it stays Restrained by you until the end of your next turn.

outcomes.failure: Half damage, and it slips your grip: it is no longer Restrained.
outcomes.ruin: It twists free and throws you down: you are Prone, and it is no longer Restrained.
